mentions.name: kev-gpt (tiny LLM in FPGA fabric)
mentions.description: This project implements a tiny LLM entirely in FPGA fabric, achieving an aggregate peak throughput of 60,000 tokens/s with a 'usable' model running at 21,000 tokens/s. It includes a live demo, a writeup, and open-source HDL source code.
mentions.source_excerpt: a live demo of a tiny-llm implemented in FPGA fabric, hitting an aggregate peak of 60,000tok/s, but a 'usable' model at 21,000tok/s
mentions.author: mikeayles
